newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 96 wine exports reach record A$550m.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 96 wine exports reach record A$550m.

text.p: Australian bottled wine exports now exceeded three million bottles per week and earnt a record A$551.2 million in calendar 1996, up 35.5 percent on 1995, the Australian Wine Export Council said on Thursday.
Deputy chairman Ian Sutton said export growth was also strong in volume, rising 28 percent to 148.2 million litres.
"We are now exporting into 60 countries and, almost without exception, the growth is strong," he said in a statement.

Sutton said exports rose 35 percent to A$252 million to Britain, 43 percent to A$97.4 million to the United States, 25.6 percent to A$39.4 million to New Zealand and 47.6 percent to A$28.8 million to Canada.
Sweden was the only market to lose ground, down 6.6 percent to A$14.6 million, he said.

Sutton said that with domestic consumption up six percent to 325.4 million litres in the 12 months period ended November 1996, the industry could pass 500 million litres in annual sales by June 30, 1997.
"We now look forward to the 1997 vintage which is due to commence in the Hunter Valley (New South Wales) within a week or so," he said.
